title: The D-RECORD-REAL-HASH case re-implements the buy-row persistence inside the test and asserts on its own copy, and its source check only counts text patterns, so a buy that lands without a trades row passes it

evidence.note: persistBuyRow is defined inside the test ("the production buy success path, reduced to its persistence wiring") and the assertions read its own insertTradeRun spy; no src code runs
the source check counts txHash: realHash ?? 'mev_bundle' occurrences (>= 2) and greps for the seam
the V2 catch that treats any error after submission as a clean failure (AUD-BUY-002)

sibling_sites_checked: Other tests of the buy-row recording: bot/noDoubleBuyReconcile and bot/deliberateBuy* (deliberate path, real insert call observed); bot/snipeFailClean (asserts no row on a throw, AUD-TESTU-014). No unit test runs handleNewPairForChain or handleNewV3PoolForChain to a successful insert.
severity_rationale: S2: a hollow test on the money path (it tests its own copy of the wiring) whose claim is the D-RECORD-REAL-HASH harm, so the registered S1 AUD-BUY-002 (landed buy with no trades row) stays invisible.
recommendation: Phase 28: drive the real V2 and V3 snipe handlers to a landed buy (mocked strategy edge only) and assert the inserted row and its hash; delete the in-test copy.
affected_cases: D-RECORD-REAL-HASH: buy success path records trades.tx_hash === real hash, not 'mev_bundle' (insert-wiring observable)
D-RECORD-REAL-HASH: src/bot.ts wires realHash into BOTH the V2 and V3 buy inserts (source/behavior coupling)
escaped_regression: Move the insertTrade.run at src/bot.ts:1127 after a later await that can throw (for example the decodeReceipt call), so a landed buy that hits the error reaches the catch at :1177 with no row: the first case still passes (it never runs bot.ts) and the source check still finds two txHash: realHash ?? 'mev_bundle' literals.
